purpose: Teach: 現像/楽屋/田園/器官/武蔵野/生理学/緑地/合体

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古いフィルムを現像に出したわ
lines.en: Sho, your father dropped off some old film at the developer.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Easy pacing. A simple fact offered as information, the way a mother shares the day with her son. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとお芝居の楽屋見学したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me backstage at a theatre! I got to see everything.
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Words tumble forward. The opening quick and unguarded. Rises slightly at the end—wanting her to feel what he felt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが田園地帯のお家に住んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather lives out in the countryside, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, steady pace. Affectionate but matter-of-fact. The tone of someone sharing something she wants him to understand and remember. Gently grounded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、生物の器官の図を描いてみたよ
lines.en: Mom, I drew a diagram of biological organs today. Look at what I made.
lines.style: Proud but not boastful. Careful emphasis on the accomplishment. Quieter than the first excitement—this is something he's genuinely proud of and wants recognized.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが武蔵野の景色のお話してくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was telling me about the landscape around Musashino.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant but warm. She's sharing something beautiful that moved her. Even pacing. A small moment of her own thinking woven in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんは生理学のお仕事してらっしゃるのね
lines.en: Mom, so Dad's a physiologist, isn't he? That's what he does.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful realization. Not a question—a confirmation he's arriving at. Gentle curiosity underneath, not challenging. The tone of understanding something new about the world.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭の隣の緑地公園で遊びましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go play in the green park next to our garden soon.
lines.style: Warm invitation. Unhurried, gentle. The slight lilt of togetherness at the end. Open and welcoming, the voice of a mother offering a simple joy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、戦隊ロボの合体玩具欲しいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want one of those Sentai robot toys that combine together.
lines.style: Direct, eager. The need stated plainly but not demanding—this is something he wants and he's telling her. Slight breath of hope underneath. Honest child-voice.
